units.source_text: 很快夏天过去了，初秋来临。

en.t: Before long, summer passed and early autumn arrived.

units.source_text: 有一天，丈夫去商社上班前，想要换干净的衣领。

en.t: One day, before leaving for work at the trading company, her husband wanted to change into a clean collar.

units.source_text: 但当时所有的衣领都送去洗衣店了。

en.t: But at the time, all the collars had been sent to the laundry.

units.source_text: 丈夫非常爱干净，于是耷拉下了脸，一边整理西裤的吊带，一边反常不悦的叨叨：“你只忙着写小说，那我可惨了。”

en.t: Her husband was extremely fastidious, so his face fell; as he adjusted the suspenders of his trousers, he grumbled with unusual displeasure, "If you spend all your time writing novels, I am the one who suffers."

units.source_text: 信子只好垂着眼睑，默不吭声的为丈夫清扫外套上的灰。

en.t: Nobuko had no choice but to lower her eyes and silently brush the dust from her husband's jacket.
